Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 108 total shipments; only 5 individual shipment rows were visible on the free view (plus buyer-aggregate table: IMPERIAL LLC 45, MELIGRO DIZAYN LIMITED 26, MILSTONE MARBLE WORKS 15, JSC VIVA TRADING 7). note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destinations (Lithuania, Israel, Russia) and HS codes, so this is not a 'declared only' case. Domestic supply side could not be verified: web_search was unavailable during this run (searx connection refused) and volza.com returned HTTP 403, so no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record was retrieved — recorded as null/unknown rather than guessed. Address on the customs record is "PLOT NO 217B DG-II BLOCK VIKAS PURI, CONTACT NO: 1165640621" (Delhi), which is a trading-office style address, not a quarry/plant; role (manufacturer vs trader) not established from shipment data alone. Note the plural slug variant https://importkey.com/countries/india/rainbow-stone-exports returned an empty record set, so the singular slug is the correct entity match. Legal name 'JEET MARBLE' claimed in the input was NOT corroborated by any source seen — no registry or catalogue check was in scope here, so it remains unverified. No sanctions/court/ownership findings were assessed (out of scope for this role).
